questions.stem: Sickle cell patient, severe joint/back pain, known diagnosis, no fever.
questions.work: Analgesia per the age-appropriate Patient Comfort Protocol, plus NS 20 mL/kg IV if dehydrated

questions.stem: Sickle cell patient with fever, chest pain, cough, and hypoxia.
questions.work: A vaso-occlusive crisis with pulmonary involvement; also treat per respiratory distress

questions.stem: Hemophilia A vs B: which clotting factor is low in each?
questions.answer: A: factor VIII (more common). B: factor IX.
questions.work: Same signs and symptoms in both

questions.stem: History of Addison’s disease, hypotension not responding to IV fluids.
questions.work: RI 2.03: hydrocortisone 100 mg IV (preferred), or methylprednisolone 125 mg IV, or dexamethasone 10 mg IV

source.doc: AEMT textbook Ch 21: Endocrine and Hematologic Emergencies (lecture slides)

questions.stem: Normal nonfasting blood glucose range?
questions.work: RI treats bG ≤60 mg/dL as hypoglycemia needing action

questions.stem: Type 1 vs type 2 diabetes: which patient can still make some of their own insulin?
questions.work: The pancreas still produces insulin in type 2 (the body is resistant to it); type 1 makes none and is always insulin-dependent
